code.commit_note: Preparation parent; actual immutable pushed runtime OID recorded after unique launch

execution.stop_rule: Technical failure fails only its lane; healthy lanes finish. No automatic retry, no stopping for weak support diagnostics.
execution.gpu_policy: CPU2 / BLAS2 / CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; fixed support caches; healthy query unchanged
execution.ground_transfer_accounting: Conservative already_deployed=false, full two-file component payload counted; native wire/model initial transfer N/A
execution.fresh_independent_validation: Deferred by explicit user request; diagnostic is not query performance

permissions.truth_use: Legal inner-held support labels supervise adapter; outer-held labels only score frozen predictions; no query

construction_audit.bytes_scope: Actual ndarray buffers and serialized data-only certificate bytes; rational integer bytes are logical repeated-value payload, excluding signs/type/object overhead
construction_audit.error_scope: Encloses the exact orthonormal basis of the stored float64 Q; no head/JVP/score/generalization certificate
construction_audit.operation_scope: Instrumented rational algebra/comparisons and enclosure integer arithmetic; loop/sign/shape/serialization control predicates and Fraction internal gcd/allocation counts are not measured
construction_audit.integer_limit_scope: Conservative cross-product/intermediate bounds before arithmetic; decoded binary64 ratios have a fixed maximum of 1075 bits

ground_A_binding.transfer_unavailable_reason: No transfer performed or measured by scorer

ground_payload_audit.transfer_scope: These two component files only; excludes model, support, transport framing and other artifacts
ground_payload_audit.registry_schema_definition: All nonnumeric-payload ndarray storage, including scalar residual_rank metadata

ground_geometry_binding.interpretation: Frozen center fixes feature directions; target support trains adapter/head elsewhere
